svg.title: Fallback first: the shopper never sees an error. Tier 1, AI ranking: the model ranks and enriches the top candidates and successful responses are cached. Tier 2, when ranking fails: rule based picks, each with its own LLM explanation built from customer reviews. Tier 3, final fallback: rule based picks with hand written reasons, which always returns valid recommendations; an empty cart match falls back to top rated products. Each OpenRouter call has a 30 second timeout and up to 3 retries with exponential backoff: 1 second, then 2, then 4, capped at 10 seconds. Malformed JSON is repaired, for example by stripping code fences, before validation with Pydantic. AI versus deterministic: product matching is a rule based dictionary; recommendation explanations and review summaries are LLM powered with a fallback; product search is filter and regex; cart logic is React state.

section.h2: Three tiers, so the shopper never sees an error.
section.p: If the API is down, slow or returns bad JSON, the system steps down a tier. Failures are logged on the server, never shown to the user.

div.p: The model ranks the top candidates and writes the full reasoning. Good answers are cached.
Rule picks, each explained by the model from its customer reviews.
Hand written reasons. No match? Top rated products. Always returns valid picks.

div.div: Exponential backoff on every OpenRouter call

ul.li: 30 s request timeout, 3 retries, delay doubles from 1 s
Bad JSON is repaired (code fences stripped) before Pydantic validation

div.div: AI where it adds trust, rules where it must be predictable
